ui.title: Schotter Studio
ui.tagline: Stochastic grid dispersion after Georg Nees

column_count.hint: Density of the vertical plotter matrix

chaos_factor.hint: Controls maximum angle and displacement at the base

cycle_speed.hint: Rate of the settling and scattering oscillation

palette_mode.hint: Switch between ink, CRT phosphor, and print palettes

gallery.blurb: In the spirit of Georg Nees' Schotter: a column of squares whose rotation and displacement grow from orderly at the top to scattered at the bottom, the column slowly settling and scattering again.
gallery.prompt: In the spirit of Georg Nees' Schotter: a column of squares whose rotation and displacement grow from orderly at the top to scattered at the bottom, the column slowly settling and scattering again. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
